claim: current702 contains 702 project benchmark labels: 685 bronze and 17 silver, with zero project-gold labels; 683 were automation-curated and 19 author-reviewed.
current_wording: Describe current702 as a project benchmark-label surface with its exact tier and review composition.
rationale: The registry audit supports these counts; neither upstream source curation nor project automation makes a project label gold.

claim: The combined 10,001-row surface comprises 8,305 positive fingerprint assignments and 1,696 out-of-scope protein-label records.
current_wording: Report positive assignments and OOS/control records separately; do not call the total mechanisms.
rationale: Rows are protein-label records across a much smaller project taxonomy, not independently established mechanism objects.

claim: The chemistry evaluation recovered 160/210 coarse cofactor buckets (76.19%) and 65/210 exact fingerprints (30.95%) on its featurizable, centroid-covered positive subset.
current_wording: Call 76.19% coarse cofactor-bucket consistency and report the 30.95% exact result beside it.
rationale: The coarse endpoint was substituted for the exact fingerprint endpoint and does not establish mechanism recovery at fine granularity.

claim: Catalytic Earth covers about 2% of mechanism space.
current_wording: No percentage of global mechanism-space coverage is claimed until a mechanism unit and denominator are formally defined.
rationale: Rhea reactions, M-CSA exemplars, EC classes, ontology families, fingerprints, and protein records are not commensurate units.

claim: The 2026-06-28 M-CSA evaluation was a never-touched independent holdout.
current_wording: Treat it as retrospective analysis of an exhausted surface; all 126 later-frozen rows had already appeared in scored project artifacts.
rationale: Renaming or preregistering an already scored surface does not restore independence.

claim: The 2026-06-29 Swiss-Prot/PDB-holo surface is independent mechanism gold and supports a broad deployable mechanism claim.
current_wording: Describe it as a spent EC-proxy validation set: 45/64 in-scope recovery, including 2/16 metal, and 2/72 OOS false positives; the 40% OOS ceiling was too permissive for deployment.
rationale: The fixed EC-to-family mapping supplies proxy family labels, not independently adjudicated stepwise mechanisms, and the aggregate hides the metal failure.

claim: Structure retrieval outperformed pairwise Smith-Waterman on a selected evaluation surface.
current_wording: Keep the selected-surface result diagnostic until profile, family, structure-template, reaction, and current learned baselines are run on a disjoint set.
rationale: A weak pairwise sequence baseline cannot establish that structure generally beats mature sequence or profile methods.

claim: Automated active-site checks verify candidate mechanisms.
current_wording: Call these computational active-site or geometry consistency checks; reserve verified for independent review or experiment with a declared evidence tier.
rationale: Automated residue and geometry agreement is useful evidence but is not expert adjudication or experimental verification.

claim: The preserved Python 3.13 audit ran 2,559 tests with 74 failures, 20 errors, and one skip; after root-cause correction and remediation, the pinned complete suite ran 2,586 tests with zero failures, zero errors, and one skip.
current_wording: Preserve both runs. Fifty-four failed tests contained 179 CRLF-only hash comparisons, not content drift; one genuine historical lineage mismatch is quarantined without rehashing. A green software suite is not scientific validation.
rationale: The initial failure counts were real, but the review over-attributed them to stale checked-in hashes. Exact Git-blob comparison separated checkout newline effects from the single genuine lineage drift, and the complete suite was rerun after bounded repairs.

claim: The bounded public-repository audit found no evidence of fabricated raw results, invented structures, or falsified Foldseek outputs.
current_wording: State this only with the bounded-audit and intent-not-inferable qualifications.
rationale: Absence of observed fabrication in a bounded public audit is not proof about every private action or artifact.

claim: Catalytic Earth is a research scaffold for an open computable catalytic-mechanism atlas, not yet a validated global atlas, validated predictor, or production biological design system.
current_wording: Keep the full atlas as the mission while labeling the current implementation and evidence honestly.
rationale: The project has structured assets, reproducible release checks, and source-scoped compilation. It still lacks independent validation and prospective biological validation at atlas scale.

claim: Protected registry writes and new performance headlines remain frozen after the truth-reset implementation until an explicit reviewed post-reset admission decision changes the machine gate.
current_wording: P0 completion does not silently lift the registry safety latch. The owner-authorized September computational policy permits source-scoped draft development after evidence-backed challenge and adjudication, without requiring human submissions. It does not establish independent validation, expand protected registries, or create performance-claim authority.
rationale: The mechanical gates now exist, but preserving an explicit transition prevents cleanup completion from being mistaken for authority to expand labels or make new performance claims.

claim: The 22-row Option-B off-M-CSA bronze surface is frozen and recorded as unscored in the initial exposure ledger.
current_wording: It may be spent once only under its frozen contract; bronze labels limit the strength of any resulting claim.
rationale: Unlike the reused M-CSA surface, this row set was enumerated and content-hashed before the proposed router repair and has no recorded score event.

claim: Family-selected and three-family views produced after inspecting a result are exploratory and require a fresh disjoint test.
current_wording: Preserve post-hoc views in the posthoc namespace and never present them as preregistered confirmatory endpoints.
rationale: Selecting a successful family subset after observing the decomposition changes the endpoint and cannot support the original validation claim.

claim: The tested structural-orphan hypothesis failed on the current families because Pfam revealed the family of every putative structural orphan.
current_wording: Retain the original predictor hypothesis and its negative result as first-class records; the atlas reframe does not turn the failure into a success.
rationale: A project north star must not become unfalsifiable by discarding the narrower prediction that motivated a test.

claim: Human GFAT2/O94808 is PLP-dependent because it belongs to EC 2.6.1.*.
current_wording: Withdraw the blanket proxy assignment, preserve the historical row, and exclude or independently adjudicate it before reuse.
rationale: EC 2.6.1.16 describes lysine-ketimine/transamidination chemistry and does not justify the PLP-family mapping applied by the proxy rule.

claim: A0A177THN5 has APX-specific donor chemistry because its nearest characterized structural neighbour is L-ascorbate peroxidase P48534.
current_wording: Withdraw the APX-specific transfer and retire the larger APX-versus-CcP study based on it. Retain a class-I-like heme-peroxidase hypothesis; CcP-like is a provisional working interpretation, not experimentally established specificity.
rationale: Global structural agreement and shared catalytic residues do not distinguish these donor-specific activities. Current UniProt is unreviewed; the Ccp1-like InterPro family includes both CcP and APX.

claim: Sequence-unmutated 1SUP deposits a PMS covalent modification on catalytic Ser221 and alternative His64 conformations; 1PQ5 is a pH-5, partially occupied, source-described autoproteolytic fragment context.
current_wording: Preserve chemical state, atom-specific occupancy and alternative conformations when comparing catalytic arrangements. Neither structure establishes a generic productive catalytic template or a kinetic population. Two new annotations cover existing cases, not additional proteins, reactions or mechanism cases.
rationale: The deposited covalent connection and modification, alternative atom rows, and primary-article context limit transfer independently of sequence identity.

claim: 6HA3 assembly 1 operator 2 supplies Glu366 beside the operator-1 cofactor/Gln160 neighborhood. E366Q F6P-intermediate nondetection, residual X5P/R5P turnover and unavailable pre-steady-state reporting are distinct source endpoints.
current_wording: A single-copy crop omits a study-implicated group. Preserve operator-qualified atom identity and the source-scoped omission warning without asserting a complete active site, causal distance, abolished catalysis, or independent experimental assembly support.
rationale: Retained assembly operators resolve the partner copy; the primary study assigns a cofactor-activation role and reports a qualitative F6P endpoint separately from measurable X5P/R5P turnover and reporter unavailability.

claim: The primary SaMGT elongation model places the growing glycan at donor site S2 and incoming lipid II at acceptor site S1; the prior M0970 polymer-acceptor label is corrected. The 3VMT paper describes a bound GalNAc analogue unable to serve as an E100 substrate.
current_wording: The current source view corrects the role beside its source context while retaining historical reports and source-only permissions. The four-PGT direction experiment is not a direct Q99T05/SaMGT test. Exact product, numeric chain length, processivity and the complete M0970 mechanism remain unresolved.
rationale: Exact primary-source model and analogue statements correct a project role reversal; discriminating biochemical direction evidence is retained at its tested-construct scope, with conflicting M-CSA prose preserved.

claim: 1MDL cites the exact K166R paper and declares a P11444-referenced Arg166/Lys166 difference. The deposit models distinct R- and S-mandelate instances; its suggested racemization origin for SMN is depositor interpretation.
current_wording: Retain the citation-bound deposited variant and separate ligand instances without inferring a new turnover event, exact assay-preparation identity, H297N structure or source-atom correspondence. Conflicting organism metadata remains unresolved; the existing six-observation query is unchanged.
rationale: Primary citation, sequence-reference, engineered-difference and ligand rows provide a bounded structural context while depositor language and conflicting gene-source metadata limit transfer.

claim: Retained 2QUT has author Tyr363 OH over 24 angstrom from same-chain deposited 13P C1/C3 in A/B/C and no modeled Tyr363 in D, while all four chains retain Lys229–13P covalent connections. Declared assembly 1 uses identity operator 1.
current_wording: The deposited enamine does not furnish the source-proposed mobile Tyr proton-transfer pose. Preserve atom and chain identity without inferring absent catalysis, dynamics, populations, a reacting-atom map, kinetics or a design-distance threshold. Existing annotation counts and evidence tiers are unchanged.
rationale: Recomputed distances and atom-row coverage separate covalent intermediate identity from the source-proposed catalytic arrangement. All selected cross-chain terminal-carbon distances in the declared assembly are also remote; unmodeled coordinates are not physical residue deletion.

claim: Retained 3CSM contains two TSA inhibitor instances and two regulatory TRP instances, with four deposited P32178 reference-sequence conflicts per chain at unmodeled positions 218–221.
current_wording: Describe one source annotation of an existing panel candidate; preserve inhibitor chemistry, reference conflicts and exact selected coordinate context without substrate/transition-state transfer, engineered-variant inference or new mechanism/observation counts.
rationale: The retained PDB source directly identifies the inhibitor/regulatory ligands and labels the sequence differences as conflicts. Exact selected rows and assembly distances support this bounded context, not the M0081 mechanism or design performance.

claim: The retained human-transketolase study reports E160A F6P-adduct k_forward 8.33 +/- 1.21 s^-1 versus wild type 9.06 +/- 0.72 s^-1 at 4 C, and E160A X5P/R5P k_cat 0.21 +/- 0.02 s^-1 versus wild type 2.79 +/- 0.06 s^-1 at 20 C. These are distinct functional endpoints.
current_wording: Describe seven source-bound variant comparison rows from one published study. Preserve T382E/Q K_0.5 versus K_M, endpoint-specific Hill coefficients, instrument lower bounds, reporter missingness and the unresolved printed T382E efficiency token. Do not infer productive F6P turnover, a generic structure-to-activity label, causal geometry, new experiments or a higher evidence tier.
rationale: The retained table image, endpoint-defining footnotes and Supplementary Methods permit quantitative within-assay contrasts while preventing silent transfer across substrates, temperatures, fitted parameter types and unavailable measurements.

claim: The retained L. plantarum POX table reports E59Q MAP-analogue nonbinding with unavailable binding parameters alongside source-reported fitted pyruvate/DCPIP k_cat 0.49 +/- 0.01 s^-1 and anaerobic pyruvate/FAD apparent processing k_app_max 1.07 +/- 0.08 s^-1 at 25 C.
current_wording: Describe six source-bound variant rows across three distinct assays. MAP forms a covalent conjugate that is not further processed; its K_D_app is not pyruvate affinity. The FAD processing rate combines microscopic steps; the DCPIP assay replaces oxygen. No generic inactivity, oxygen-turnover rate, elementary-step rate, causal geometry, new experiment or evidence-tier promotion follows.
rationale: The exact table, footnotes h-k and Supplementary Methods preserve chemical, reporter and fitted-parameter identity. An explicit relation to the prior TKT annotation also separates source-reported analogue nonbinding from unavailable reporter signal.

claim: In the retained RA95.5-5 fluorescence comparison, K210M retains displayed kcat/KM 490 M^-1 s^-1 while kcat changes from 0.048 +/- 0.007 to 0.023 +/- 0.001 s^-1; K83M has reported efficiency 2.3 M^-1 s^-1.
current_wording: Bind designed-enzyme outcomes to the exact variant background, substrate, assay and parameter. Preserve positive reported parameter values in engineered double-substitution derivatives of evolved backgrounds and RA95.0-K210M nondetection without a numeric detection limit. Four complete sequences are source-printed; eight mutant strings are derived. KM unit conflicts and unmarked-row assay identity remain unresolved; no generic inactivity, exact assay-specimen verification, design success rate, productive geometry or new validation follows.
rationale: The primary study, complete tagged sequences, mutation definitions and assay-specific table rows prevent name-only construct joins and endpoint-blind catalytic-role transfer. The primary study already reports remodeling; the atlas adds reusable evidence-qualified associations.

claim: The retained KE59 main article supplies five apparent-pKa pairs and declared variant substitutions, but no exact-sequence-bound E230 replacement assay. The author assignment of the pH shoulder to E230 is tentative; unacquired supplementary material remains unassessed.
current_wording: Keep original KE59, R1 structural proxy and R2 pH proxy distinct. E230 is not a declared substitution in the selected rows, but neither exact sequence retention nor continued catalytic function follows. Preserve Table2 R4 pKa(kcat)=5.5 beside the prose range6.1-6.7. No full-apparatus retention, paper-wide absence, productive geometry, causal E230 assignment, design success rate or independent validation is established.
rationale: The source assessment prevents pH-derived parameters, declared substitutions, inhibitor structure interpretations and MD proposals from being collapsed into a categorical catalytic-role label. This is an indirect-evidence contrast to RA95 substitution sensitivity, not a counterclaim that one system retains and the other relocates its catalytic machinery.

claim: The 2013 RA95.0 construct favors S-methodol cleavage while RA95.5-8 favors R-methodol. Their source-reported R/S efficiency factors are 0.43 and 14; higher activity does not establish preservation of the intended substrate preference.
current_wording: Keep the post-RA95.5 racemic cell-lysate screening separate from enantiopure UV-vis characterization. Eight R/S rows and four printed factors reuse four exact construct providers. RA95.5 retains its author-reported R preference but its inconsistent S kinetic triplet blocks an integrated preference label. Printed factors and displayed-efficiency quotients remain distinct; no repaired kinetics, reverse-synthesis selectivity, single-residue cause, exact assay specimen, prospective design success or new experiment is established. The 2013 starting clone differs from the earlier same-named design.
rationale: Substrate stereochemistry, construct identity, assay context, parameter identity and source consistency determine whether a published activity outcome can support a design-preference label. A selected trajectory does not establish that the selection substrate caused the reversal.

claim: In the retained RA61 Table 4, all five assayed designed-water-motif mutant constructs increase displayed initial-rate (kcat/KM)obs. Tyr78Phe/Ser87Ala is 2.6 versus parent 0.49 M^-1 s^-1, with printed mutant/parent ratio 5.3.
current_wording: Retain the response at the named-background composite initial-rate endpoint, with no demonstrated net benefit from the modeled motif. Do not infer absent water, an isolated microscopic contribution, productive geometry or later catalytic-step behavior. The roughly 500-fold substrate-interaction contribution is a cross-substrate/two-amine estimate with readout/solvent differences; the roughly 10-fold pKa contribution assumes a transferred solution Brønsted model. Six named RA61 constructs have no acquired exact sequence. No new experiment, full mechanism, design-success estimate or tier promotion follows.
rationale: Design intent, same-background perturbation, substrate discrimination and apparent-ionization/model evidence support different claims. The source packet preserves those distinctions and the off-pathway product-fluorescence limitation, rather than assigning a functioning designed apparatus from activity alone.

claim: Main-text benzoate noninhibition up to 2.5 mM conflicts with visibly lower S4 bars at 2.5 mM. The S4 caption names RAβb-16.2 while the crystal is RAβb-16.1; no ligand-independent template follows.
current_wording: Retain positive named-variant cleavage parameters, exact 120-residue deposited 8AH9 sequence and explicit residue/ligand/alternate coordinates, while assay-specimen identity remains unverified. Preserve the benzoate prose/plot and variant mismatch, kinetic pH 7/7.5 conflict and mutation-informed docking limits. No numeric inhibition effect, statistical significance, K53 knockout rate, productive geometry, full mechanism, new experiment or evidence-tier promotion is established.
rationale: The atlas joins the precise control variant, source figure and structural specimen to prevent transfer of a blanket ligand-independent catalytic-arrangement label that the published evidence does not support.

claim: In the acquired Obexer2017 supplement, matched RA95.5-8F Y51F/Y180F double-substitution central values depart from a multiplicative reference constructed from parent and single mutants. Observed/reference is 0.021 for kcat, approximately 0.423 for KM and approximately 0.050 for printed kcat/KM.
current_wording: Describe parameter-specific nonmultiplicativity of source-reported central values. Y180F has printed efficiency 33600 versus parent 33800 M^-1 s^-1, while the Y51F/Y180F double has 170 versus Y51F 3400. Preserve all seven kinetic, thermal and mass rows separately, exact/derived sequence status and the two source mutation-list discrepancies. Missing Asn double combinations prevent three-way decomposition. No significance, microscopic cooperative mechanism, energetic coupling, active-fraction proof, productive geometry, full-tetrad completeness, new experiment or tier promotion follows. Main article body remains unacquired and unassessed.
rationale: A complete same-background paired substitution comparison establishes conditional outcome effects at the declared assay/parameter scope. Near-parent single-mutant efficiency cannot justify independent group dispensability. Lower KM, differing melting points, source mass constraints and incomplete combinations bound mechanistic interpretation.
